messages:
michael: Quick check — planning to remove default model pin for /v1/generate next week. Is everyone ok with the deprecation timeline? Need: compatibility matrix, SDK fallback behavior, docs blurb.

neha: Do we mean removing server-side default and requiring Accept-Model header? If so we should publish a 2-week grace window + telemetry flags.

sam: SDK note: current JS/Go SDK auto-pins to 'default' if header missing. I'll open a PR to change to explicit error when feature flag enabled. Can we do an opt-in release first? :thinking: 

olga: Ops: recommend canary in us-west with 1% traffic. Rollback if error rate > 0.5% or latency p99 regresses by >20ms. Also add a metric: requests_with_missing_accept_model.

michael: Agreed. For docs, propose this blurb:
```
We will require Accept-Model header when calling /v1/generate. Clients without header will fallback to pinned variants for 14 days, then receive 400 with guidance.
```
Can someone paste the exact header name/shape for the SDKs?

sam: header is `Accept-Model: gpt-4o-redwood@v1` — SDK PR will emit that by default if user sets model param. If not set, we can return 400 with `x-error-code: missing_model_header`.

neha: Add a temporary compatibility flag `require_accept_model: false` in account settings. We'll flip to true on deprecation day.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started on cluster-us-west-2 (canary id c-789). Monitor: /observability/deploys/c-789

olga: Also add an eval set to watch for quality regressions. If we see hallucination rate delta > 0.8% switch fallback to last-known-good model.

michael: TL;DR action items: sam PR for SDK fallback, neha config flag and docs blurb, olga canary thresholds and monitoring dashboard, I'll draft customer comms. Ping me once PRs link.

neha: I'll attach the config change here once it's in infra repo. ETA EOD today. :thumbsup:

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 — updates behavior for missing header and log tags `compat:accept-model`

michael: Awesome. We'll run the canary for 48h. If no regressions, schedule global flip next Tuesday. Thanks all. :rocket:
